## Orientation

Worktree: `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--retry-loop`. Code commits only there on `phase/retry-loop`. Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call `adaptive-artifacts`. Parallel task `retry-engine` owns `contract/`, `skills/`, and `tests/test_retry_loop.py` — do not touch those paths.

Territory: `dashboard/` and dashboard tests (`tests/test_dashboard_model.py`, `tests/test_dashboard_app.py`) with `-k attempt`.

Requirement R8: The dashboard shows attempt n/budget on retried work-item rows. Default per-task budget is 2 when run facts omit overrides.

Design invariants: single writer (you write code only); do not call adaptive-artifacts.

Decisions:
- retry-loop-scope: Full #7 (includes dashboard attempts)
- retry-budget: defaults 2 re-dispatches (use for n/budget denominator)

Commit on the phase branch when done (exclude .artifacts). Return the evidence block only.
